    About this model

    Built from the builder's own drawings (ground, first and top floor, Oct 2026) with the changes of Rev 2b. Room sizes are his labels and the bedroom names are from our design; door swings follow his door arcs. His plans give no heights, so these are assumed from our design: plinth 3'-6" above the road, 11'-8" floor to floor, windows 3'-0" to 7'-0" (bathroom vents 5'-0" to 7'-0"), doors 7'-0", terrace walls 3'-6", roof walls 3'-0", boundary wall 7'-0" from the road. The car port is at road level. The ramp beside the 5'-0" car-port steps (Rev 2b) climbs the 3'-0" in about 9'-5" (about 1 in 3) - steep, for use with a helper. The 6'-0" front gate opens outwards because his steps start only 1'-5" inside it. Furniture is as he drew it, simplified. Fans, lights, the kitchen chimney, plants, trees and the neighbours' houses are illustrative only. Textures from Poly Haven (CC0). Not a construction drawing.
